pointerEventsNote: Zindikirani: Zochitika za cholozera zazimitsidwa kotero kugunda sikudzichotsa kokha mukaika cholozera
breakpointSizesNote: Makulidwe amatchulidwa ndi m'lifupi, osati chipangizo, kotero muyeso womwewo umafotokoza zenera (mawonekedwe) kapena m'lifupi mwa chinthu chomwecho (grid-plate). Ma CSS variable sangagwiritsidwe ntchito mkati mwa media query, choncho lowetsani manambala:
readableFromJsViaCssVariables: Zowerengeka kuchokera ku JS kudzera mu ma css variable:
layoutWidthAliasesNote: Mawonekedwe amafotokoza zigawo zawo ndi mayina ena {contentWidth}, {sidebarWidth}, {containerWidth} ndi {layoutGutter}. Zinthu za gridi zimagwiritsa ntchito {gridGap} ndi {gridItemSpacing}.
availableColorsPolaris: Mitundu Yomwe Ilipo kuchokera ku Mawonekedwe a Polaris
availableFunctionalColorsPolaris: Mitundu ya Ntchito Yomwe Ilipo kuchokera ku Mawonekedwe a Polaris
availablePalettesInDdd: Magulu a mitundu omwe alipo mu DDD
palettePickerIntro: Chitsanzo choyambirira cha gawo choyendetsedwa ndi mndandanda cha zokonda za maonekedwe a HAX, chogwiritsa ntchito kapangidwe ka deta ka mitundu kofanana ndi DDD.
themePaletteDescription: Sankhani gulu la mitundu; mtengo uwu umalembedwa ngati data-palette attribute pa mlingo wa mawonekedwe.
darkContextDescription: Chithunzithunzi cha kuwerengeka ndi mkhalidwe wosankhidwa m'mawonekedwe amdima.
availableGradientsPolaris: Ma Gradient Omwe Alipo kuchokera ku Mawonekedwe a Polaris
spacingSides: Mbali: Pamwamba (t), Kumanja (r), Pansi (b), Kumanzere (l), X (x), Y (y)
letterSpacingVariableNote: CSS Variable ndi yofanana ndi dzina la kalasi, ndi chiyambi cha '--ddd-'
richTextHeading: Kalembedwe ka mawu olemera ndi zoonetsera zina za deta
otherHtmlTextTypes: Mitundu ina ya mawu a html
inlineCodeExample: Ichi ndi chitsanzo cha code:{code} m'ndime
blockCodeExample: Nachi chitsanzo cha chipika cha code chokha, pogwiritsa ntchito kalasi ya 'block-code', mobwerezabwereza, koma kumapewa dzina la kalasi lofala la 'block'
highlightExampleText: Nayi mtundu wautali kwambiri wa Mawu Owunikira omwe amapitirira kumapeto kwa bokosi la malire
underlineWays: Pali njira 2 zopezera kalembedwe ka mzere pansi
defaultHrLine: Mzere wopingasa wokhazikika pogwiritsa ntchito chinthu cha hr
hrDataPrimaryNote: zinthu za hr zimalandiranso mitengo ya data-primary, ndipo zinapangidwa kuti zigwirizane bwino zikaikidwa mkati mwa chinthu cha mutu
hrFitContentNote: Zikaphatikizidwa ndi width: fit-content pa mutu womwewo, zitha kuchepetsa mzere wapansi kuti ukhale wofanana ndendende ndi mawu
variableLengthDesignTreatment: Kapena, ngati mukufuna kutalika kosiyanasiyana, gwiritsani ntchito design-treatment:
accentContrastNote: Zindikirani: Mtundu wowonjezera sudzaikidwa ngati mtundu waukulu sukukwaniritsa zofunikira za kusiyana
haxCapabilityGap: Kusowa kwa kuthekera kwa HAX: {components} sizingagwire ntchito ndi HAX. Kapangidwe kameneka kalembedwa koma sikanasindikizidwe pa njira yoikira mpaka kulumikiza kutapangidwa.
internalContractsIntro: Mapangano odutsa m'magawo onse a mkati mwa zinthu (mitu, zidziwitso, zopindika, zolowetsedwa, magulu a woyang'anira). Izi ndi zomwe luso la hax-pattern-library-audit limayesa; kukakamiza mu chilengedwe chonse ndi ntchito ya m'tsogolo.
